mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study (user_id, post_id, title, location, max_member, deadline, state, created_at, delete_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{title}, #{location}, #{maxMember}, #{deadline}, #{state}, now(), NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, title, location, max_member, state FROM study WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_at IS NULL
SELECT id, title, location, max_member, state FROM study WHERE post_id = #{id} AND delete_at IS NULL
SELECT id, post_id, user_id, title, location, max_member, state FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL
SELECT id, post_id, user_id, title, location, max_member, state FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT user_id FROM study_participant WHERE study_id = #{studyId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE study SET state = 'CLOSED', modified_at = now() WHERE state = 'RECRUITING' AND deadline < now() AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM study WHERE state = 'RECRUITING' AND deadline < now() AND delete_at IS NULL
